requirement.value: Captain (Commander) or Blackguard (Darkblade) mastery + Charging Cavalry and Shadow Strike

system.description: When you use Shadow Strike you may treat your High Roll as 0 when determining that attack's damage. If you do, once Shadow Strike's effects resolve, you may immediately perform Charging Cavalry for free — paying its MP cost as normal. Live: it was filed as a dead letter solely because Commander was believed to be out of the lineup.
